The distance between pole and centre of curvature is called radius of curvature of the mirror. d. The straight line joining the pole and centre of curvature is called principal axis. e. The point on the principal axis through which parallel rays to the principal axis passes or appear to pass after reflection. f. The diameter of the mirror or size of the mirror is called aperture. g. The distance between focus and pole of a mirror is the focal length of the mirror.
